title: Wound Component EST Analyzer 19036
seoDescription: 5-in-1 composite analyzer scanner for wound components, suited to EV motor test solutions.

props.title: Wound Component EST Analyzer 19036
paragraphs: 5-in-1 composite analyzer scanner for wound components, suited to EV motor test solutions.

props.body:
- 5 in 1 composite analyzer scanner (ACW / DCW / IR / IWT / DCR)
- 5kV AC / 6kV DC Hipot test
- 5kV insulation resistance test
- Impulse Winding Tester (IWT)
- 10 channels 4-wire DCR test
- L/Q test with 3252 (option)
